Title: The Godfather
Cast: Marlon Brando, Al Pacino, James Caan, Robert Duvall, Diane Keaton
Plot: In 1945 New York City, Don Vito Corleone, head of the Corleone mafia family, oversees the wedding of his daughter Connie. Vito's youngest son Michael, a decorated World War II marine who initially wants no part of the family criminal enterprise, is drawn into a violent mob war after an assassination attempt on Vito by rival drug kingpin Virgil Sollozzo.

Title: The Lion King
Cast: Matthew Broderick, James Earl Jones, Jeremy Irons, Whoopi Goldberg
Plot: In the Pride Lands of Africa, lion cub Simba is crowned heir by King Mufasa. After Mufasa's villainous brother Scar orchestrates Mufasa's murder in a wildebeest stampede and convinces Simba he was responsible, Simba flees into exile, where he befriends Timon and Pumbaa before returning to reclaim his throne.

Title: Iron Man
Cast: Robert Downey Jr., Terrence Howard, Jeff Bridges, Gwyneth Paltrow
Plot: Genius industrialist and weapons manufacturer Tony Stark is ambushed and captured by a terrorist group in Afghanistan. Suffering from a shrapnel chest injury, Stark builds an electromagnet chest reactor and an armored exoskeleton suit to escape captivity, subsequently renouncing weapons manufacturing to become the superhero Iron Man.

Title: The Matrix
Cast: Keanu Reeves, Laurence Fishburne, Carrie-Anne Moss, Hugo Weaving
Plot: Thomas Anderson, a computer programmer living a double life as the hacker Neo, discovers from mysterious rebel Morpheus that humanity is trapped in a simulated reality created by sentient machines, joining the rebellion to liberate humanity.

Title: Spirited Away
Cast: Rumi Hiiragi, Miyu Irino, Mari Natsuki, Takashi Naito
Plot: Ten-year-old Chihiro Ogino and her parents inadvertently enter the world of Kami (spirits of Japanese folklore). After her parents are magically transformed into pigs by the witch Yubaba, Chihiro takes a job working in Yubaba's bathhouse to find a way to free herself and her parents and return to the human world.
